select r.rule_id ruleId, r.room_id roomId, lr.room_name roomName, r.enabled, r.max_active_per_owner maxActivePerOwner, r.reclaim_hours reclaimHours, r.next_member_index nextMemberIndex, r.qualification_enabled qualificationEnabled, r.comment_rank_threshold commentRankThreshold, r.watch_rank_threshold watchRankThreshold, r.min_pay_level minPayLevel, r.min_visit_days minVisitDays, r.follower_qualifies followerQualifies, r.following_qualifies followingQualifies, r.update_by updateBy, r.update_time updateTime from dy_audience_assignment_rule r left join live_room lr on lr.room_id = r.room_id order by lr.room_name, r.room_id

select r.rule_id ruleId, r.room_id roomId, lr.room_name roomName, r.enabled, r.max_active_per_owner maxActivePerOwner, r.reclaim_hours reclaimHours, r.next_member_index nextMemberIndex, r.qualification_enabled qualificationEnabled, r.comment_rank_threshold commentRankThreshold, r.watch_rank_threshold watchRankThreshold, r.min_pay_level minPayLevel, r.min_visit_days minVisitDays, r.follower_qualifies followerQualifies, r.following_qualifies followingQualifies, r.update_by updateBy, r.update_time updateTime from dy_audience_assignment_rule r left join live_room lr on lr.room_id = r.room_id where r.room_id = #{roomId} limit 1

select m.user_id userId, u.nick_name userName, u.user_name account, u.phonenumber mobile, m.sort_order sortOrder from dy_audience_assignment_member m join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' where m.rule_id = #{ruleId} and m.enabled = 1 order by m.sort_order, m.member_id
mapper.insert: insert into dy_audience_assignment_rule( room_id, enabled, max_active_per_owner, reclaim_hours, next_member_index, qualification_enabled, comment_rank_threshold, watch_rank_threshold, min_pay_level, min_visit_days, follower_qualifies, following_qualifies, update_by, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{roomId}, #{enabled}, #{maxActivePerOwner}, #{reclaimHours}, #{nextMemberIndex}, #{qualificationEnabled}, #{commentRankThreshold}, #{watchRankThreshold}, #{minPayLevel}, #{minVisitDays}, #{followerQualifies}, #{followingQualifies}, #{updateBy}, sysdate(), sysdate() ) on duplicate key update rule_id = last_insert_id(rule_id), enabled = values(enabled), max_active_per_owner = values(max_active_per_owner), reclaim_hours = values(reclaim_hours), qualification_enabled = values(qualification_enabled), comment_rank_threshold = values(comment_rank_threshold), watch_rank_threshold = values(watch_rank_threshold), min_pay_level = values(min_pay_level), min_visit_days = values(min_visit_days), follower_qualifies = values(follower_qualifies), following_qualifies = values(following_qualifies), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = sysdate()

insert into dy_audience_assignment_member( rule_id, user_id, sort_order, enabled, create_time ) values
(#{ruleId}, #{userId}, #{index}, 1, sysdate())
mapper.select: select from dy_audience_followup f left join dy_audience_rank_snapshot s on s.batch_id = f.last_source_batch_id and s.sec_uid = f.sec_uid where f.room_id = #{roomId} and f.owner_user_id is not null and f.status = 'PENDING' and f.last_contact_at is null and coalesce(f.status_changed_at, f.update_time, f.create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval #{reclaimHours} hour) order by coalesce(f.status_changed_at, f.update_time, f.create_time), f.followup_id limit #{limit}

select from dy_audience_followup f left join dy_audience_rank_snapshot s on s.batch_id = f.last_source_batch_id and s.sec_uid = f.sec_uid where f.room_id = #{roomId} and f.status = 'UNASSIGNED' order by f.priority desc, f.last_seen_at desc, f.followup_id limit #{limit}
